## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] README / CONTRIBUTING updated if behaviour, formats or the layout changed
- [ ] No request is made with the user's data, and the Content-Security-Policy is not loosened
- [ ] A private key never ends up in a link, a log, storage or the clipboard unasked
